visual_style: The speaker on screen with large dynamic captions and occasional punch-ins.
rights_requirements: Only footage you own, have permission to use, or can lawfully use — upload it to the post.
render_notes: Clips keep their own sound; captions are what is said, as heard.
Punch-ins crop to a region of the frame.
platform_notes: Preserve the speaker's meaning and context.
format: the strongest moments of an interview or podcast, with big captions of what is said and punch-ins
